comparison.objective: Assemble two spacer halves around a captive shaft whose head blocks top-down installation.
comparison.physical_skill: Bimanual split-part placement and closure around an obstruction.
comparison.success_condition: Both halves enclose the shaft with both seam gaps within 4 mm.
comparison.reason: Constrained split-part assembly does not involve impact tooling, controlled material separation, retained-insert protection, or fragment disposal.
